decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.
Condition : 3 - A schedule for all new windows, sills, doors (internal and external) and architraves (and any repair works to existing) at scale 1:5 (or as appropriate) be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Authority in consultation with English Heritage before the commence of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 4 - A method statement for all repair and restoration works (including any works to the floors, joists, skirtings, fireplaces, panelling and architrave) at ground and first floor level shall be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Authority in consultation with English Heritage before the commence of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 5 - Sample panels of brickwork showing the proposed colour, texture, face-bond and pointing (including brick arches) shall be provided on site and approved by the Local Planning Authority in consultation with English Heritage before the works are commenced and the sample panels shall be retained on site until the work is completed and has been approved.

Condition : 6 - A detail of the proposed fireplace to the living room shall be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority in consultation with English Heritage before the commence of works.

Condition : 7 - No plumbing or pipes, other than rainwater pipes, shall be fixed on the external faces of the building unless shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 8 - The rooflight shall be a flush conservation type.

Condition : 9 - Detailed drawings at scale 1:5 shall be submitted and approved by the Local Planning Authority of the works to the new stair, general finishes, the opening between kitchen original finishes and utility at basement level.
description: Creation of 3 openings, 2 new windows at front basement level, replacement of rear entrance doors at ground floor level, new windows to 1st floor rear of house, 2 new rear rooflights and lowering of basement and relocation of kitchen to ground floor level of existing dwellinghouse. (LIsted Building)
